headline: Nigeria FMCG Sector Exposed to FX and Commodity Risks, Says SBG Report
summary: A report by SBG Securities highlighted that Nigeria's fast-moving consumer goods sector remains vulnerable to exchange rate fluctuations, global commodity prices, and high financing costs due to imported raw materials.
why: Consumer goods companies rely on imported inputs, making them sensitive to foreign exchange availability and currency devaluations.

impacts.name: Nigerian consumer goods sector
impacts.why: Exposure to foreign exchange volatility and raw material import costs squeezes corporate operating margins.
